text:
ravi: hi all, day 1 and trying to access Console staging flags page — getting 403. Help?
sam: welcome! usually missing the staging flag read role. Did you accept the Okta provisioning email?
ravi: accepted, shows in Okta app but UI still 403. I tried curl and got "missing:console.flag.read".
sam: are you on SSO session or a service token? SSO claims can lag after provisioning.
ravi: browser SSO. no token yet.
devex-bot: Created JIT access for ravi (req #610), expires in 2h. Approvers: infra, sam.
sam: I granted a temporary staging-flag-admin for 1h while infra checks mappings. Try logging out/in.
pat: infra-oncall kicking off Okta->RBAC sync now, saw a group mapping omitted.
infra-oncall: sync finished; mapping added: Okta group "eng-staging-flag-read" -> RBAC "console.flag.read".
ravi: confirmed! flags page loads :tada: Thanks.
ravi: one more Q — recommended way to flip a staging canary?
sam: interactive via Console canary UI. For scripts use rwctl: `rwctl flags toggle --env staging --flag my-feature --on --reason "ravi onboarding smoke" --actor ravi`
devex-bot: Audit note recorded for temporary grant; extension requests go to sam with justification.
ravi: will add this to onboarding notes and include the rwctl snippet. Thanks everyone!
